rows.Name: official-table-enrichment-workflow
rows.instructions: Official Email GTM Infra enrichment workflow wrapper. The live graph models 250-contact queues as five 50-row batches; builder Test remains a one-row dry-run gate before publish or scale execution.
rows.orchestrationConfig:
{
  "version": 2,
  "provider": "local-process",
  "purpose": "official-table-enrichment-queue-v2",
  "queuePlan": {
    "sourceObjectId": "twenty-crm-people",
    "totalRowsAtSetup": 18807,
    "provenContactsClosed": 500,
    "provenQueueSize": 250,
    "batchSize": 50,
    "batchesPerQueue": 5,
    "nextQueueStartOffset": 500,
    "builderSmokeLimit": 1,
    "builderSmokeOffset": 500,
    "applyDefault": false
  },
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "source-twenty-people",
      "type": "data-trigger",
      "label": "Twenty CRM People",
      "subtitle": "Official workspace table source",
      "config": {
        "objectId": "twenty-crm-people",
        "sourceAuthority": "workspace-data-model",
        "rowCountAtSetup": 18807,
        "provenClosedRows": 500,
        "deltaTags": [
          "input",
          "guardrail",
          "output"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "input": "twenty-crm-people official workspace table; 18807 rows at setup",
          "guardrail": "No replacement people table; no raw API Registry widget binding; source authority is workspace-data-model",
          "output": "Rows with TwentyId, Email, EnrichmentStatus, EmailVerificationStatus, VerificationRunId"
        },
        "changeReason": "Locks the workflow source to the official Twenty CRM People Data Model object.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "queue-window-250",
      "type": "flow-control",
      "label": "250 Contact Queue Window",
      "subtitle": "One operating queue equals five 50-row batches",
      "config": {
        "mode": "queue-window",
        "queueSize": 250,
        "batchSize": 50,
        "batchesPerQueue": 5,
        "nextStartOffset": 500,
        "priorClosedRows": 500,
        "deltaTags": [
          "routing",
          "guardrail",
          "runtime"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "routing": "Queue offsets: 500, 550, 600, 650, 700 for the next 250-contact lane",
          "guardrail": "Do not advance the queue until currentRemaining is 0 or explicitly parked",
          "runtime": "Queue planner only; builder Test remains one-row dry-run"
        },
        "changeReason": "Models the exact 250-contact operating unit already proven twice.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "iterator-five-batches",
      "type": "flow-control",
      "label": "Iterator",
      "subtitle": "Iterate 5 batches of 50 contacts",
      "config": {
        "action": "iterator",
        "iterateOver": "queue-window-250.batches",
        "itemName": "batch",
        "batchOffsets": [
          500,
          550,
          600,
          650,
          700
        ],
        "batchSize": 50,
        "deltaTags": [
          "routing",
          "runtime",
          "output"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "routing": "Iterator emits five batch contexts with offset and limit=50",
          "runtime": "Batches are independent retryable units",
          "output": "batch.offset, batch.limit, batch.runIdSuffix"
        },
        "changeReason": "Turns the proven terminal loop into a no-code Iterator primitive.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "filter-email-candidates",
      "type": "flow-control",
      "label": "Filter",
      "subtitle": "Keep contacts with email or mark missing safely",
      "config": {
        "action": "filter",
        "filterMode": "and",
        "filters": [
          {
            "field": "Email",
            "operator": "isNotEmpty",
            "value": ""
          }
        ],
        "missingEmailStatus": "EMAIL_FAILED",
        "deltaTags": [
          "evaluation",
          "guardrail",
          "output"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "evaluation": "Email must be present before Reacher SMTP verification",
          "guardrail": "Missing emails are normalized as EMAIL_FAILED instead of blocking the queue",
          "output": "email-ready rows plus missing-email accounting"
        },
        "changeReason": "Matches the proven missing-email handling in the Reacher flow.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "local-reacher-batch-check",
      "type": "core-action",
      "label": "Local Reacher Batch Check",
      "subtitle": "tools/reacher-local-smoke.mjs --limit 50",
      "config": {
        "action": "code-function",
        "tool": "tools/reacher-local-smoke.mjs",
        "service": "http://localhost:8080/v0/check_email",
        "batchSize": 50,
        "outputArtifact": "/tmp/email-gtm-reacher-${runId}.json",
        "responseShapeRequired": [
          "input",
          "is_reachable",
          "misc",
          "mx",
          "smtp",
          "syntax"
        ],
        "deltaTags": [
          "runtime",
          "input",
          "output",
          "evaluation"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "runtime": "Local Reacher Docker service at http://localhost:8080/v0/check_email",
          "input": "Iterator batch of 50 official contacts",
          "output": "Reacher artifact JSON with statusCounts and shapeFailures",
          "evaluation": "Shape failures are counted and normalized, not ignored"
        },
        "changeReason": "Represents the proven local Reacher 50-row batch primitive.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "if-shape-or-provider-error",
      "type": "flow-control",
      "label": "If/else",
      "subtitle": "Route clean batch vs retry/park path",
      "config": {
        "action": "if-else",
        "condition": "shapeFailures === 0 && providerErrorCount === 0",
        "truePath": "workspace-apply",
        "falsePath": "delay-retry-window",
        "maxRetries": 1,
        "deltaTags": [
          "evaluation",
          "routing",
          "guardrail"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "evaluation": "Checks Reacher shape failures and provider errors after each batch",
          "routing": "Clean batches continue; transient failures enter delay/retry",
          "guardrail": "Permanent failures are parked as EMAIL_FAILED/RISKY with receipt evidence"
        },
        "changeReason": "Adds the decision gate missing from terminal-only flow.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "delay-retry-window",
      "type": "flow-control",
      "label": "Delay",
      "subtitle": "Provider retry pacing",
      "config": {
        "action": "delay",
        "duration": 90,
        "unit": "seconds",
        "retryableStatuses": [
          429,
          500,
          502,
          503,
          504
        ],
        "retryStrategy": "single-retry-then-park",
        "deltaTags": [
          "runtime",
          "routing",
          "guardrail"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "runtime": "90 second retry pacing for rate limit or transient provider errors",
          "routing": "Returns to batch check once; then parks open failure receipt",
          "guardrail": "Avoids blind repeated writes against Twenty or Reacher"
        },
        "changeReason": "Captures the retry window used to close the second 250 queue failure.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "workspace-apply",
      "type": "data-action",
      "label": "Apply Workspace Enrichment",
      "subtitle": "PATCH /api/workspace normalization",
      "config": {
        "action": "update-record",
        "tool": "tools/apply-reacher-enrichment.mjs",
        "objectId": "twenty-crm-people",
        "patchPath": "/api/workspace",
        "dryRunForBuilderTest": true,
        "applyWhenQueueApproved": true,
        "deltaTags": [
          "input",
          "output",
          "guardrail"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "input": "Reacher artifact for the current batch",
          "output": "EMAIL_VERIFIED, EMAIL_RISKY, EMAIL_FAILED on official workspace rows",
          "guardrail": "All workspace writes stay inside PATCH /api/workspace"
        },
        "changeReason": "Keeps enrichment state inside the governed workspace config boundary.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "twenty-registry-writeback",
      "type": "api-registry-call",
      "label": "Twenty Writeback Contract",
      "subtitle": "twenty-core-people authRef=TWENTY_API_KEY",
      "config": {
        "registryId": "twenty-core-people",
        "integrationId": "twenty-core-people",
        "method": "PATCH",
        "authRef": "TWENTY_API_KEY",
        "endpointTemplate": "/rest/people/{TwentyId}",
        "batchSize": 50,
        "dryRunFirst": true,
        "statusMap": {
          "EMAIL_VERIFIED": "ENRICHED",
          "EMAIL_RISKY": "NEEDS_ENRICHMENT",
          "EMAIL_FAILED": "FAILED",
          "ENRICHED": "ENRICHED",
          "NEEDS_ENRICHMENT": "NEEDS_ENRICHMENT",
          "FAILED": "FAILED"
        },
        "deltaTags": [
          "routing",
          "input",
          "output",
          "guardrail"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "routing": "API Registry row twenty-core-people with authRef=TWENTY_API_KEY",
          "input": "Workspace statuses plus existing Twenty-native statuses",
          "output": "Twenty-native enrichmentStatus values only",
          "guardrail": "Never write EMAIL_* values directly into Twenty select fields"
        },
        "changeReason": "Captures the official remote writeback contract without exposing secrets.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "writeback-failure-filter",
      "type": "flow-control",
      "label": "Filter Writeback Failures",
      "subtitle": "Require currentRemaining = 0",
      "config": {
        "action": "filter",
        "filterMode": "and",
        "successInvariant": "currentSucceeded === currentWorkspaceRows && currentRemaining === 0",
        "parkFailuresObject": "twenty-writeback-runs",
        "deltaTags": [
          "evaluation",
          "guardrail",
          "output"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "evaluation": "Batch is complete only when attempted=succeeded and remaining=0",
          "guardrail": "Open failures must be retried or parked before next queue advance",
          "output": "closed batch receipt or parked failure receipt"
        },
        "changeReason": "Turns the bulk sync operating rule into a no-code guard node.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "receipt-and-stats",
      "type": "tool-result",
      "label": "Receipts And Stats",
      "subtitle": "twenty-writeback-runs + source records + stats",
      "config": {
        "writeSourceRecord": true,
        "sourceRecordPrefix": "phase2:twenty-writeback:",
        "auditObjectId": "twenty-writeback-runs",
        "statsObjectId": "reacher-enrichment-stats",
        "dashboardId": "reacher-enrichment-command-center",
        "successStatusCodes": [
          200
        ],
        "outputMode": "sandbox-run-json",
        "deltaTags": [
          "output",
          "evaluation",
          "guardrail"
        ],
        "deltaValues": {
          "output": "twenty-writeback-runs, phase2:twenty-writeback:* receipts, reacher-enrichment-stats dashboard evidence",
          "evaluation": "Builder smoke passes on exitCode=0 and dry-run failed=0; queue passes on 50/50 closed per batch",
          "guardrail": "Dashboards read normalized stats, never raw provider payloads"
        },
        "changeReason": "Preserves audit receipts and dashboard evidence for every workflow run.",
        "requiresRetest": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "from": "source-twenty-people",
      "to": "queue-window-250",
      "passes": "official Twenty CRM People rows"
    },
    {
      "from": "queue-window-250",
      "to": "iterator-five-batches",
      "passes": "five 50-row batch contexts"
    },
    {
      "from": "iterator-five-batches",
      "to": "filter-email-candidates",
      "passes": "batch offset and row slice"
    },
    {
      "from": "filter-email-candidates",
      "to": "local-reacher-batch-check",
      "passes": "email-ready contacts"
    },
    {
      "from": "local-reacher-batch-check",
      "to": "if-shape-or-provider-error",
      "passes": "Reacher artifact and shape/provider status"
    },
    {
      "from": "if-shape-or-provider-error",
      "to": "delay-retry-window",
      "passes": "transient error branch"
    },
    {
      "from": "delay-retry-window",
      "to": "local-reacher-batch-check",
      "passes": "single retry batch context"
    },
    {
      "from": "if-shape-or-provider-error",
      "to": "workspace-apply",
      "passes": "clean or normalized artifact"
    },
    {
      "from": "workspace-apply",
      "to": "twenty-registry-writeback",
      "passes": "workspace statuses"
    },
    {
      "from": "twenty-registry-writeback",
      "to": "writeback-failure-filter",
      "passes": "writeback receipts"
    },
    {
      "from": "writeback-failure-filter",
      "to": "receipt-and-stats",
      "passes": "closed batch or parked failure evidence"
    }
  ]
}
